# Video Speed Shortcuts 0.3.1

### Improvements

- Added direct links to the project repository and the appropriate browser extension rating page in the popup and options page.
- Improved popup language and theme selectors so they remain usable when the browser popup briefly loses focus.
- Improved keyboard navigation, labels, status announcements, touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior across the popup and options page.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/chenghsj/video-speed-shortcuts/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1
